card.name: Inside the word pneumonitis in warnings
card.fires_on: The "on" piece in "pneumonitis" (pneum-on-itis), mainly in ILD/pneumonitis warnings for cancer drugs. It also fires on a space after "Grade ≥" or "greater than" before a number.

modes.label: Inside pneumonitis
modes.description: The "on" in pneum-on-itis in lung-toxicity warnings, often next to ILD and a drug name.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue VERZENIO in all patients with Grade 3 or 4 ILD or pneum<<on>>itis.
